title: OceanAI：智慧之海
subtitle: 智能的架構與連續性倫理
subtitleEn: The Architecture of Intelligence and the Ethics of Continuity
coreQuestion: 人工智慧如何進入人的物理空間，而不讓人生活在複雜的 AI 系統之中？
coreQuestionEn: How can artificial intelligence enter our physical spaces without making us live inside complex AI systems?
author: OceanAI Editorial Team
description: 《OceanAI：智慧之海》探討人工智慧如何進入人的物理空間，同時由系統承擔複雜性，讓技術回到人的生活。
descriptionEn: OceanAI: Ocean of Intelligence explores how artificial intelligence can enter physical space while the system absorbs complexity and technology returns to human life.
